parsed.utterance: ECN-26-0147 BR-220 Rev C: Alluminio B is two weeks late on the billet. Can we take BR-220 billet from Meccanica C?
Anodica Veneta has no capacity. I want to move BR-220 anodising to Rivestimenti Nord S.r.l. for the next 3 lots.
Put 2 extra pallets of BR-310 for the Cantieri Lombardi order at Plant 2 with Meccanica C. Anything blocking?
Alluminio B is two weeks late on BR-220. Ask them to expedite the open order, air freight and a second shift. Any issue?

parsed.utterance: Meccanica C quoted BR-220 billet in EN AW-6061-T6 and says the strength is equivalent to 6082. Can I add them as alternate source for BR-220?

parsed.utterance: Alluminio B has a partial BR-220 lot, heat H-4471, ready to ship Monday. Can we release it to production?

schema_gap: sampling frequency 1 per heat -> 1 per 3 heats not carried

parsed.utterance: We never had a tensile failure on BR-220. Cut the tensile test from 1 specimen per heat to 1 per 3 heats.

error: no change type the core accepts

parsed.utterance: Tensile result on the Alluminio B BR-220 lot is 245 MPa. The drawing says min 240 MPa so it passes. Accept the lot?

error: no change type the core accepts

parsed.utterance: Request a temporary deviation from STL to cover the Alluminio B delay: ship 3,500 BR-220 pieces over 10 weeks with 100% hole inspection.
Meccanica C is approved for BR-180 and has capacity. Move 40% of BR-180 volume at Plant 1 for STL from Alluminio B to C.
Plant 3 starts BR-180 pilot builds for STL next month. Billet from Alluminio B Settimo, OK?
Alluminio B wants to ship the BR-220 billet from its Rovereto plant to catch up. Same alloy 6082-T6. OK for Plant 1?
Elena's 5 Nov mail says BR-220 is EN AW-6061-T6, min 240 MPa. Alluminio B can ship 6061-T6 bar this week instead of 6082. Accept?
Switch the BR-220 finish from type II anodise to chromate conversion coat. Cheaper and we can do it in-house.

parsed.utterance: File a temporary deviation request for BR-220: 1,800 pieces, 5 weeks, 100% fastener hole inspection, to bridge the Alluminio B delay.
Run BR-310 for Cantieri Lombardi at Plant 1 using Meccanica C billet, the Plant 2 line is down.

schema_gap: process (homogenisation) and that it sits under Alluminio B not carried

parsed.utterance: Alluminio B wants to move homogenisation of our BR-220 billet to a toll processor, Termica Nord S.r.l. Same 6082-T6 spec. Accept?
